title: 2019-09-17 Meeting notes - Onboarding to CBF GtiHub
content:
Date

Meeting Date: 2019-09-17 14:30

Location: Skype Meeting

Attendees

 (Meeting Organizer)

Jathisan Chandrasegaram (Accepted in Outlook)

 (Accepted in Outlook)


Goal


Get access to CBF GitHub for evaluation of integration to Jira


Notes

Jathisan is working as domain architect with Marketing & insights, data analytics, Azure datalakes , python coder, web developemnt

Jathisan is acting super user for CBF GitHub account, Terraform, AzureDevops.

This responsibility will be handed ver to someone in Digital and IT team which will be responsible for all DevOps tools,


Current setup for Marketing & insights use Github for storing code only

Azure DevOps is use for CI/CD

CBF is part of GitHub beta program, this means access to github actions, component repository

There is no internal person dedicated to support => use online GuitHub support

We pay per user not per repository

Repository responsible are accountable for user administration

External users can use existing user

It is not possible to make repositories public

Mail github.support@inter-ikea.com to get a new repo. use template.xls, amount of developers colum is an estimate

CBF has a github.com account i.e. SaaS => using one organization, github.com/inter-ikea

If need approval on organization level for tools e.g. Jira then contact Jathisan.

Demo of POC that shows cost related overview of all IPEX Azure subscriptions

Action items

1 complete  Send template.xls with requested info for first IPEX repo to github.support@inter-ikea.com
